author: haiku
label: climb-05-01
changes: No junior questions or answers were supplied, so the rewrite is based on the document, the brief and the existing-code files alone.
Added a plain summary of how sending works today (the per-batch commit, the 5-second poll and the duplicate problem) before describing the change.
Added a Terms section defining outbox, broker, ack, inbox, claim, lease, idempotency key, flag, attempt and handed off.

Removed the internal rule, decision and step codes (R, D, Q labels) and cross-references. Each step now states its own start, data, state and failure. Open questions are written out in plain words at the end.
Merged the six rules and the per-step failure lists into one failure table, keeping only step-specific failure notes in the steps themselves.
Separated how the system runs (summary, status table, rules, daily checks, failure table) from how it is built and rolled out (steps 1 to 9, rollback).
Cut the repeated retry-schedule text and the duplicated 'as in step 6' detail where it was not needed. Kept the retry policy once, in the rules section.
Clarified that the service has its own copy of the notifications table and a status_outbox table, and that the monolith's table is the outbox and record.
Clarified step 2's crash-before-call case: no duplicate, because MailRelay never accepted the first call.
Replaced the 'Decision D2 covers the remainder' pointer with the list of open questions. Kept every number, gate, soak period, flag name and retry value unchanged, so the plan's intent is unchanged.

Kept the 24-hour window, the 15-minute retry total and the 60-second p99 gate as stated, and moved the open decisions (retention, MailRelay window, personal data, sandbox proof, clocks, template ownership, sender after removal, automatic fallback) into the open-questions list with their proposals.
